native_mechanisms: Fold each mark into the impure cup one at a time, the cup's new colour seeding the next pull, so the whole pile passes as one unbroken chained pour (never judged alone or twice).
Carry the cup's final colour through seven successive organ-bendings, each discarding half of what it received (shift away half the bits) and keeping only what refuses to sit still (xor).
Avalanche audit: flip one mark anywhere in the pile, re-pour from the first cup, and discard the whole method if the new token resembles the old.
core_technique: Table-driven reflected CRC-64/Jones accumulator (slicing-by-8 over the body, byte-at-a-time tail, bit-identical) finished by a MurmurHash3/SplitMix64-style xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer.
